info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS Glue API (2017-03-31). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Data Catalog databases and tables, job definitions and crawler definitions are stored metadata: no job run, crawl, schedule, trigger, partition, statistics, Lake Formation permission or data access is performed, and StartJobRun, StartCrawler and other run APIs return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Names are not folded to lowercase, so database and table names with uppercase letters are refused. Resource links (TargetDatabase, TargetTable), federation, default Lake Formation permissions, multi-dialect views, transactions, Iceberg inputs, crawler schedules and job source control are refused. Updates change only the supplied members instead of replacing the whole definition, renames are refused, and table versions are not kept. Deleting a database deletes its tables. DeleteJob of a missing job fails instead of succeeding. Referenced roles, S3 locations, scripts, connections, classifiers, security configurations and crawler target databases are stored without checking that they exist; tags are accepted for every stored Glue resource.
